# GymTracker — Global Project Context

## What This App Is
GymTracker is a **React Native 0.84.1** (React 19, TypeScript strict) MVP for tracking personal gym workouts.
It is **local-only, single-user, no backend**.

## MVP Features
1. **Auth** — Biometric (Face ID / Touch ID) with PIN as fallback
2. **Workout Logging** — Create workouts, add exercises, log sets/reps/weight
3. **Exercise Library** — Browse seeded exercises + create custom ones (name + photo)
4. **Settings** — Enable/disable biometrics, choose theme (dark / light / system)

## Tech Stack
| Concern | Library |
|---|---|
| Framework | React Native 0.84.1, React 19, TypeScript strict |
| Navigation | React Navigation v7 (native-stack, bottom-tabs) |
| State | Zustand |
| Key-Value Store | react-native-mmkv |
| Secure Storage | react-native-keychain |
| Database | @op-engineering/op-sqlite + drizzle-orm |
| Biometrics | react-native-biometrics |
| Icons | react-native-svg |
| Testing | Jest, @testing-library/react-native, react-test-renderer |

## Project Folder Structure
```
src/
  features/
    auth/           # PIN + biometrics
    workout/        # Workout logging
    exercises/      # Exercise library
    settings/       # App settings
  shared/
    components/     # Reusable UI primitives (each in its own folder)
    hooks/          # Hooks used by 2+ features
    utils/          # Pure helpers used by 2+ features
    constants/      # App-wide constants
    theme/          # ThemeProvider, useTheme, design tokens
    icons/          # Raw SVG icon files — used only via the Icon component
  db/
    schema/         # Drizzle table definitions
    migrations/     # Auto-generated by drizzle-kit
    repositories/   # Data access layer (one file per table)
  navigation/       # RootNavigator + stack/tab navigators
  store/            # Zustand slices index
```

## Non-Negotiable Rules
- TypeScript strict — zero `any`, zero `ts-ignore` without comment
- Named exports only — no default exports
- No hardcoded colors — always `useTheme()`
- Screens are thin — logic belongs in custom hooks
- All DB access through repositories — never raw Drizzle in components
- Every file must have a corresponding test file
